coverage.remaining: Nothing of the 1910 daily lists is known to remain unread: all 365 issues the four batches hold were scanned. 1,123 candidate blocks were dropped unread as not a list (fewer than two 'line of'/'corner of' phrases) - 876 entry-shape hits sampled as rooming-house and want-ads, the rest stray 'contract' headlines - and 43 heading blocks among them were rescued and read because they carried the entry's 'with ... - ... $' shape. Of the 1,099 unresolved, 341 have no parcel matching the lot or offset with a roll year near 1910, 253 single candidates were refused (side of the street, roll year, storeys), 13 match several parcels, 74 are on streets EAS no longer joins (Cushman, Clark, Congress, the Bayview 'avenues South', Hermann at Valencia), 400 could not be measured (no cross street, no quadrant, an illegible offset), 15 print a number with no EAS record and 3 a number on a parcel rebuilt since.
coverage.note: 8,437 OCR pages scanned (every page of 1910 in curiv_jenner, curiv_klamath, curiv_mecca and curiv_needles); 300 page-blocks located by the list's heading and the entry's shape, plus 43 heading blocks rescued from the not-a-list filter; 343 blocks read by twelve parallel readers from one written spec, 1,365 contract entries read, every raw span verified verbatim against its block; 4 reprints and 1 overlapping read collapsed, and 45 entries set aside because the same printing is already in an earlier 1910 batch of this source (the Saturday section re-reads, #407 and #412) - 1,315 findings (1,195 building contracts, 120 alterations). 216 resolved - 207 by hand (184 by corner, offset and lot with corner.py's geometry, 23 on a building the record names) and 9 on a printed street number - and 1,099 unresolved, each with its reason. 167 published on 167 pages, 82 of them seeded by this run; 49 declined - 44 further contracts for a building whose entry already carries one, 4 already on their pages from this source's Saturday pages on the same day, 1 trade contract for a building whose page carries its general contract.

notes: The San Francisco Call's daily Building Contracts list for the whole of 1910: every issue in curiv_jenner_ver01, curiv_klamath_ver01, curiv_mecca_ver01 and curiv_needles_ver01 (365 issues, 8,437 OCR pages). Located as in 1911-1913, by the list's heading matched by shape on a short line and by the entry's own shape ('with CONTRACTOR - WORK ... line/corner of ...; $AMOUNT'), the 'with' widened for 1910's OCR ('wita', 'wlta', 'witn', 'irtth'). The widened shape matched rooming-house ads by the hundred, so a block was kept only where it carried at least two 'line of'/'corner of' phrases, which the deeds column above every list does; that filter dropped some short real lists under a heading (22 January, the Odd Fellows' hall contract), so heading blocks carrying the entry shape were rescued and read. Blocks were not trimmed (1913's lesson). Read by twelve parallel readers from one written spec; private owners, estates, trustees and surname partnerships are cut from raw and extra, institutional and company owners kept in extra.owner_firm. A contractor's name garbled in one entry is corrected only where another entry prints it legibly (Secor, Demartini & Caranza); a name garbled past repair is kept as printed in the finding and printed as 'a builder' on the page. Every entry carries extra.record_date. Placed with corner.py --batch --json: a single parcel matching the record's lot within 4% or its offset within 4 ft, the roll year within two years of 1910 (an alteration: a building standing by 1910), the side of the street or quadrant of the corner the record names, and a storey count not off by 1.5 or more; a corner with neither lot nor offset only on the corner lot. Named buildings placed by hand by name - the Pacific-Union Club, the Bohemian Club, the Olympic Club, the Monadnock, the Rialto, the Merchants' Exchange, Grace Cathedral, the Ingleside police station, the French, St. Mary's, Mary's Help and Southern Pacific hospitals, the H. C. Harrison building (whose printed lot, 120 by 246:6, is the corner parcel's 29,585 sq ft). Overlap with the earlier 1910 batches of this source was matched on the address text, not street_name: their unresolved entries carry no street_name, and a key on it matched nothing. Street names onto EAS's own spelling and type (OFARRELL, GREAT HWY, Birch now a street); corner.py gained the PARK type for Clinton Park. One entry per building: the general contract, else the earliest, carries the page's entry.
